sentences.text: At this stage, the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is falsely implicated in the matter cannot be accepted.
sentences._hearing_file: Yogesh vs State Of Karnataka on 21 February, 2023.json

sentences.text: Admittedly, the victim girl is now in the Shelter Home.

sentences.text: Hence, I am of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled to be enlarged on bail subject to conditions, which will take care of the apprehension expressed by the learned High Court Government Pleader that the petitioner may abscond or may tamper or threaten the prosecution witnesses.

7. Accordingly, I answer the above point in the affirmative and proceed to pass the following:

opennyai_summary.final__issue:
In view of the rival contentions urged by the learned counsel for both the parties, the point that would arise for my consideration is:
"Whether the petitioner is entitled for grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.?"
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
My answer to the above point is in 'Affirmative' for the following:
REASONS 4.
He was apprehended on 18.11.2023 and since then, he is in judicial custody.
opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The petitioner being the sole accused is seeking grant of bail.
The victim girl was aged about 17 years, while the petitioner is said to be aged about 22 years.
The statement of the victim girl recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. by the learned Magistrate discloses that, the victim and the petitioner were having love affair and they were having physical relationship.
The mother of the victim came to know about the said fact and she advised her daughter.
The victim decided to leave her house and accordingly, she went with the petitioner and stayed in his house.
The petitioner committed sexual intercourse.
The victim became pregnant.
Her NC: 2024:KHC:20596 pregnancy was medically terminated and the same was sent to FSL examination.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Under these circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled to be enlarged on bail subject to conditions, which will take care of the interest of the prosecution.
5. Accordingly, I answer the above point in the affirmative and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The petition is allowed.
The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.137/2023 of Ramanagara Women Police Station, on obtaining the bond in a sum of Rs.2,00,000/-
(Rupees Two Lakhs only) with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court, subject to the following conditions:
NC: 2024:KHC:20596 a).
The petitioner shall not commit similar offences.
b). The petitioner shall not threaten or tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c). The petitioner shall appear before the Court as and when required.
If in case, the petitioner violates any of the conditions as stated above, the prosecution will be at liberty to move the Trial Court seeking cancellation of bail.
On furnishing the sureties by the petitioner, the Trial Court is at liberty to direct the Investigating Officer to verify the correctness of the address and authenticity of the documents furnished by the petitioner and the sureties and a report may be called for in that regard, which is to be submitted by the Investigating Officer within 5 days.
The Trial Court on satisfaction, may proceed to accept the sureties for the purpose of releasing the petitioner on bail.
